title: Detection of Dynamical Instability in Titan's Thermospheric Jet
question: Is Titan's thermospheric equatorial jet temporally variable? Map the 3D wind field with ALMA in May 2017 and compare with a reanalysis of the August 2016 data

what.value: Mean emission altitudes of the limb emission: CH3CN 345 km, HC3N 710 km, HNC 990 km

evidence.quote: CH$_3$CN emission is from a mean altitude of $\bar{z}=345$ km, HC$_3$N from $\bar{z}=710$ km and HNC from $\bar{z}=990$ km

what.value: Molecular abundance and temperature in each model cell, from limb retrievals

evidence.quote: an abundance, and a temperature (the latter two quantities were obtained from the limb retrievals of (cite: cor19))

what.value: Molecular line rest frequencies (systematic uncertainty 0.3 m/s CH3CN, 2-8 m/s HC3N, 7 m/s HNC)

evidence.quote: 0.3 m $\rm{s}^{-1}$ for CH$_3$CN, 2–8 m $\rm{s}^{-1}$ for HC$_3$N and 7 m $\rm{s}^{-1}$ for HNC (cite: pic98; mul01)

recipe.method: Continuum-subtract with low-order polynomials, then image with tclean into cubes in Titan's rest frame
key_parameters: pixel size 0.025 arcsec; threshold twice the RMS noise per channel; mask diameter 1.3 arcsec
cubes in the rest frame of Titan's center-of-mass

recipe.method: Convolve both epochs to common circular beams defined in km at Titan
assumptions: Titan geocentric distance 9.75 au (2016) and 9.21 au (2017)

recipe.method: Extract a spectrum per pixel, fit emission lines with Gaussians for the Doppler shift; for HC3N and CH3CN fit 3 MHz windows around the line cores with a constant offset; average three CH3CN lines
key_parameters: constant additive intensity offset to remove the pseudo-continuum from broad line wings
assumptions: Limb emission optically thin and thermally broadened, so the Gaussian Doppler shift gives the line-of-sight wind

recipe.goal: deconvolve to intrinsic zonal wind profiles
recipe.method: 3D grid of 100 km cubic cells with wind, abundance, temperature; radiative transfer along the line of sight, convolve to beam, centroid velocity per pixel, fit Gaussian v(latitude) profile with vmax, FWHM, phi0
key_parameters: three free parameters: peak wind speed vmax, Gaussian FWHM, latitudinal offset phi0
assumptions: Titan obliquity of 26 degrees toward the observer
v(latitude) profile does not vary with height for each molecule

recipe.method: Apply the Rayleigh-Kuo criterion (beta - Uyy < 0) to the fitted HNC latitudinal wind profile

evidence.quote: resulting in a mean absolute Doppler shift of $265\pm11$ m $\rm{s}^{-1}$ in 2016 and $142\pm6$ m $\rm{s}^{-1}$ in 2017 (averaged over the east and west limbs)
